# row9 census B-veer (VeeR EL2 / EH1)

status: DONE. Both cores run hello_world to TEST_PASSED under vita after the workarounds below; vita's output equals the oracles' (EL2: the 4-state oracle; EH1: all three).
binary: S/accept/vita-final md5=f4d778f25ab5921a472cf14fefd569e5 (measured at start and end). Never rebuilt. No cargo was run. The repo was not written.
paths: S/row9/B-veer/{el2,eh1} = clones; el2w/, eh1w/ = workaround copies (git repos: `git diff` = every edit; el2w.patch 10804 lines, mostly W24 `pt.X`->literal; eh1w.patch 770 lines); bin/apply_el2w.py, bin/apply_eh1w.py rebuild them from upstream; repros/<name>/t.sv (+ vita.out, iv.out, s2v.out, vl.out); work-el2/, work-eh1/ = logs.

## Upstream / licence
- EL2 https://github.com/chipsalliance/Cores-VeeR-EL2 0169d669eedec31f723dde006125e22c4bf83a95 (2026-10-05). LICENSE is Apache-2.0. Of the used files, 65 carry `SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0`, 6 carry the Apache text, and 11 have no header (covered by the repo LICENSE).
  - NOT Apache: testbench/axi4_mux/*.v (9 files), MIT, "Copyright (c) 2014-2021 Alex Forencich". Only the AXI4 tb uses them (tb_top.sv:545 axi_crossbar_wrap_2x1). I stopped at them and never compiled them. The EL2 tb run uses the AHB-lite build.
- EH1 https://github.com/chipsalliance/Cores-VeeR-EH1 d04b1c7ae675a63dc4307cacfd10547ec937b928 (2026-07-16). LICENSE is Apache-2.0. All 47 used files carry `SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0`.
- Programs: the canned testbench/hex/hello_world.hex (EL2 user_mode0; EH1 hex/). No toolchain was used.
- Disk: 96-97 GiB free at every verilator build. Every obj_dir was deleted after use.

Not vita roots: harness and oracle findings, all measured.
- H1 time-0 edge: the tbs tie `jtag_trst_n` to a constant 0 (EL2 `assign`, EH1 port actual). The tap's `@(negedge trst)` misses the time-0 change: vita, iverilog and sv2v print `state=xxxx`, verilator `0000` (repros/t0_negedge_const_trst). The tap stays x, then dmi reg_en, dmcontrol and core_rst_l go x (EL2 core_rst_l 1->x at t=45 in vita and identically in sv2v->iverilog). The EH1 fetch goes x at t=110 in both 4-state tools. Kind: harness-format. W22 / E22 give it a real edge at t=2.
- EL2's tb halt/run handshake hangs at `[30 ns] halting CPU and waiting for ack` in vita and in sv2v->iverilog alike. verilator acks in all 66 x-worlds. Kind: harness-format (x). Bypassed with opt-in -DCENSUS_NO_HALT_TEST (W20). W21 also ties the tb's two open dmi_uncore inputs.
- sv2v turns `bit`/`int` into 4-state regs without their implicit 0: the clock stays x, cycleCnt stays x, and the exec.log cycle column reads `x`. This is an oracle artefact. Explicit zero inits (S2) are added in the sv2v copies only.
- Diagnostics: errors inside an instance print at the instance site, and CA errors inside a generate loop print at the `module` line. This is known (the memory note "Instance-site error location"), but it made O8 and O16 slow to bisect.

## Admission candidates
- EH1: feasible.
  - Oracle: verilator, x-invariant 66/66 (rand+reset 0 and 1, seeds 1-64; trace_port.csv+console.log+exec.log md5 7dc94065...). The 4-state cross-check (sv2v->iverilog) agrees on trace_port.csv and console.log, and on exec.log minus the disassembly.
  - Program: the canned hex (hello_world is 1362 cycles; cmark.hex and dhry.hex exist for a longer digest).
  - Run time: vita 7.4 s wall to 13680 ns, verilator 0.3 s.
  - Blocking roots on unmodified RTL: O1 (or the upstream `undef ASSERT_ON` recipe), T1, O6, V4, T2, O8, O9, O11, O12, O13, O17, O18, O16. Plus harness H1 in the plain-SV tb path. The EH1 design files themselves need O1 (when ASSERT_ON), V4, T1, T2, O8, O9, O16; O6, O11, O12, O13, O17 are tb-only, and O18 is a cascade of O8.
- EL2 (AHB-lite): not admissible as-is.
  - verilator is not x-invariant (30/64 vs 34/64 seeds, two cycle counts).
  - The 4-state oracle (sv2v->iverilog, after S1/S2 and the tb patches in bin/s2v_build.sh) equals vita byte-for-byte (`[11200 ns] TEST_PASSED`, `minstret = 330, mcycle = 1117`, trace_port.csv md5 a9c26734...). A row needs an x-clean tb or a ruling that the 4-state oracle can stand alone.
  - Run time: vita 47 s wall to 26200 ns.
  - Blocking roots: V1 (silent), V3, T1, B1, B2, O2-O16 (O1, O17 and O18 are EH1-only). AXI4 default config: the MIT tb crossbar is out.
